rationale: The stock gapped up ~9% on an earnings beat but is now trading well below both the session VWAP ($203.98) and the 9-EMA ($201.63), sitting at only 25.8% of today's range with the last five 1-minute candles showing a consistent drift lower with accelerating volume on the final bar — classic post-gap fade behavior. However, the news context is mixed (beat but sell-rated with weak sector), the spread is wide at 40+ bps, and the price is caught between the day's low support (~$195.80) and significant overhead resistance at VWAP, making a clean directional setup with favorable risk/reward difficult to define at this moment.
